provenance: Authored by hand for teaching. No molecule here is a design proposal and no space is a real screening library.
what_a_space_is: A construction plus its inputs. The construction decides what is reachable, and the inputs decide how much of it there is. Quoting a size without the construction says nothing about what can be made.

enumeration.construction: one fixed core with two attachment points, each filled from a list
enumeration.size_is: the product of the list lengths, before duplicates are removed
enumeration.cannot_reach: anything whose core differs, at any list size

enumeration_grown.construction: the same core and the same two attachment points, with longer lists
enumeration_grown.size_is: the product of the longer list lengths
enumeration_grown.cannot_reach: the same things the smaller version cannot reach, because the core did not change

scaffold_hop.construction: a different fixed core with the same two attachment points, filled from the original lists
scaffold_hop.size_is: the product of the original list lengths
scaffold_hop.cannot_reach: anything on the original core, which is the point of listing it beside them

targets.description: original core, both substituents in the short lists
original core, substituents only in the long lists
a pyridine core, one atom different
a sulfonamide linker instead of an amide

what_reachability_is_not: Reachable means the construction can write the molecule down. It says nothing about whether the molecule can be made, whether it would be stable, or whether it is worth making. A space is a generator, not a plan.
